title: Aizen Private Pack
description: A Lightweight Minecraft Texture Pack Designed For SMP Type Gameplay, Old Minecraft Glint Which Feels Very Good While PvP, Cool Features That Enhance Your Experience, and Optimized Visuals.
body:
# **Aizen Private Pack**

Aizen Private Pack is a vanilla-friendly Minecraft resource pack designed to enhance the game without changing its original feel. The pack includes a golden crown, old ore textures, and various visual upgrades that make gameplay look cleaner and more enjoyable.

Whether you're playing Survival, SMPs, or simply exploring your world, this pack aims to provide a polished experience while staying true to Minecraft's iconic art style.

## **Features**

・Golden Crown

・Old Glint

・Clean Crystal

・Funny Goat Sound

・Enhance Respawn Anchor

・3d Sun & Moon

・Enhance Particles 

・Full Brightness

・Mace enchantment indicator

・Books' enchantment textures

・Enhance tools' texture 

・Improved tools models

・Enhanced block textures

・Old ores' texture

・Vanilla-friendly design

・SMP and survival-focused

・Lightweight and easy use

・Vanilla+ Experience

・Visual improvements that blend naturally with the base game

・Side Shield

・Enchant Icons

・More Visible Trims

## I will also suggest using these packs with mine to enhance your gaming experience. [Also Motion Blur]


・ [Theone's Eating Animation Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/theones-eating-animation-pack)

・[Saturated](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/saturated-pack)
